description: Source code for the DebugController class in Playwright, managing debugging, recording modes, highlighting, and event handling within the Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: DebugController
classes.description: Manages debugging, recording modes, event emission, and interaction with Playwright pages and browsers.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets the SDK language for the DebugController.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the DebugController, stopping state reporting.

methods.name: setReportStateChanged
methods.description: Enables or disables reporting of the current debugging state.

methods.name: setRecorderMode
methods.description: Sets the recording mode, manages browser and page setup, and test ID attributes.

methods.name: highlight
methods.description: Highlights elements or ARIA templates in the UI.

methods.name: hideHighlight
methods.description: Hides all element and locator highlights.

methods.name: closeBrowser
methods.description: Closes a specified browser by ID.

methods.name: _emitSnapshot
methods.description: Emits the current state snapshot of browsers and pages.

methods.name: _allRecorders
methods.description: Retrieves all recorder instances associated with current contexts.

methods.name: _closeBrowsersWithoutPages
methods.description: Closes browsers and contexts that have no pages.
